text:
## Annual Operations Report FY2025

Prepared by Group Operations

## 1. Executive Summary

FY2025 was a year of steady growth despite volatile energy prices across Europe.

Group revenue for FY2025 was EUR 412.6 million, an increase of 6.3% on the prior year.

The adjusted EBITDA margin was 14.8%.

The group lost-time injury frequency rate (LTIFR) improved to 0.62 per million hours worked.

The order backlog at year end stood at EUR 188 million.

Capital expenditure totalled EUR 27.4 million, most of it on the Porto Foundry furnace upgrade.

## 2. Site Review: Tampere Works (Finland)

The Tampere Works site in Finland is led by site director Sofia Zielinski. The table below summarises its key operating indicators for the fiscal year.

| Metric | FY2025 |
|---|---|
| Units produced | 34,520 |
| On-time delivery | 98.3% |
| Lost-time incidents | 6 |
| Energy consumption | 30,660 MWh |
| Headcount | 189 |

Improvement priorities for FY2026 include lean flow, energy efficiency and supplier quality.
